_comment: GENERATED by scripts/gen_mcu_io.py from the Microchip DFP EDC files (pack and sha256 below) -- do not hand-edit. pins = [package pin, [function names]]; ports = implemented bits per port; config_words = configuration words with fields {name, lsb, width, values [cname, value, desc]}. Everything here is DOCUMENTED (vendor device file).

fields.name: OSCIOFNC
fields.desc: CLKO Output Signal Active on the OSCO Pin

fields.name: ICESEL
values: ICE EMUC1/EMUD1 pins shared with PGC1/PGD1
ICE EMUC2/EMUD2 pins shared with PGC2/PGD2

fields.name: WPFP
fields.desc: Write Protection Flash Page Segment Boundary

fields.name: SOSCSEL
values: Secondary oscillator is in Default (high drive strength) Oscillator mode
Secondary oscillator is in Low-Power (low drive strength) Oscillator mode
External clock (SCLKI) or Digital I/O mode(

fields.name: WUTSEL
values: Fast regulator start-up time is used
Default regulator start-up time is used

fields.name: ALTPMP
values: EPMP pins are in default location mode
EPMP pins are in alternate location mode

fields.name: WPDIS
values: Segmented code protection is enabled; protected segment is defined by the WPEND, WPCFG and WPFPx Configuration bits

fields.name: WPCFG
values: Last page (at the top of program memory) and Flash Configuration Words are not write-protected
Last page and Flash Configuration Words are write-protected, provided WPDIS = 0

fields.name: WPEND
fields.desc: Segment Write Protection End Page Select
values: Protected code segment upper boundary is at the last page of program memory; the lower boundary is the code page specified by WPFP
Protected code segment lower boundary is at the bottom of the program memory (000000h); upper boundary is the code page specified by WPFP

fields.name: IOL1WAY
values: The IOLOCK bit (OSCCON<6>) can be set once, provided the unlock sequence has been completed. Once set, the Peripheral Pin Select registers cannot be written to a second time.
The IOLOCK bit can be set and cleared as needed, provided the unlock sequence has been completed

fields.name: FCKSM
fields.desc: Clock Switching and Fail-Safe Clock Monitor
values: Clock switching and Fail-Safe Clock Monitor are disabled
Clock switching is enabled, Fail-Safe Clock Monitor is disabled
Clock switching is enabled, Fail-Safe Clock Monitor is enabled

fields.name: FNOSC
values: Primary Oscillator with PLL module (XTPLL, HSPLL, ECPLL)
Fast RC Oscillator with Postscaler and PLL module (FRCPLL)

fields.name: PLL96MHZ
values: 96 MHz PLL is enabled automatically on start-up
96 MHz PLL is software controlled (can be enabled by setting the PLLEN bit in CLKDIV<5>)

fields.name: PLLDIV
values: Oscillator input is divided by 12 (48 MHz input)
Oscillator input is divided by 8 (32 MHz input)
Oscillator input is divided by 6 (24 MHz input)
Oscillator input is divided by 5 (20 MHz input)
Oscillator input is divided by 4 (16 MHz input)
Oscillator input is divided by 3 (12 MHz input)
Oscillator input is divided by 2 (8 MHz input)
Oscillator input is used directly (4 MHz input)

fields.name: ALTVREF
values: VREF is on an alternate pin (VREF+ on RB0 and VREF- on RB1)
VREF is on a default pin (VREF+ on RA9 and VREF- on RA10)

fields.name: WINDIS
values: Standard Watchdog Timer enabled,(Windowed-mode is disabled)
Windowed Watchdog Timer is enabled; FWDTEN must be 1

fields.name: ICS
values: Emulator functions are shared with PGEC3/PGED3
Emulator functions are shared with PGEC2/PGED2
Emulator functions are shared with PGEC1/PGED1

fields.name: GWRP
values: Writes to program memory are allowed
Writes to program memory are not allowed

fields.name: GCP
values: Code protection is enabled for the entire program memory space
